titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: Spain imposes border controls against Italy amid disagreement over migrant arrivals in Ceuta.
Spain imposes border checks on Italy.

Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed a defense agreement.
Over 300 people were freed in Nigeria in a single-day rescue operation.
